claims.sentence: This study is to assess LDL-C reductions at Week 52 with monthly (Q4W \[≤31 days\]) dosing of LIB003 (lerodalcibep) 300 mg administered subcutaneously (SC) compared to placebo in patients with very-high risk for CVD on a stable diet and oral LDL-C lowering drug therapy.
